text:
yuki: quick flag  ran model-onboard for aurora-slim (v2) with kvcache-rotate + q7-fast; seeing punctuation reattachment for mixed CJK+RTL. small repro and numbers below.

derek: paste sample & which commit?

yuki: commit 3f4b21a (kvcache:rotate-keys), kernel v5.2.4, quant q7-fast. quick metric snapshot: baseline (flat-cache,q8) BLEU=30.4 -> experiment (rotate+q7) BLEU=23.7.

maria: that's a big drop. can you show an example output?

yuki: sure:

```
# baseline
input: "我去路 (רכבה)."
baseline: "I went on the road (to Rakavah)."

# experiment
input: "我去路 (רכבה)."
exp out: "I went on the road )to Rakavah(."

# notes: paren mirrored, rtl fragment moved outside pairing, spacing collapsed near CJK boundary
```

derek: can you upload the failing batch to shared bucket and run factor isolation A/B? i want cache-only and quant-only runs.

yuki: uploaded -> gs://redwood-evals/multilang/6331234567.zip (80 samples). repro command: `python eval.py --model aurora-slim --kernel v5.2.4 --quant q7 --cache rotate --input tests/mixed_cjk_rtl.txt`

maria: ran quick isolates on canary: cache-only (rotate, q8) BLEU=28.6, quant-only (flat,q7) BLEU=25.1, combined -> 23.7. so both are contributing and reduce top-k stability.

eva: likely interaction between rotated kvcache fingerprint (which changes prefix alignment) and q7's reduced softmax precision. short-term mitigation: add a locale heuristic to skip rotate for any prompt that contains both Han/Katakana/Hangul and RLM/ALM ranges.

ops: note: will schedule canary patch to disable rotate for mixed-orient locales; preparing PR.

pull-request-bot: PR #4532 opened: disable-rotate-mixed-orient (owner: yuki)

maria: long-term: add a small regression harness that asserts bracket pairing and punctuation script-attachment across quant/cache combos for any onboarded model. make it part of onboard smoke. owner: derek.

yuki: opened issue R-INF-2219 with repro, logs, and bucket link. pinged @eng-runtime and @quant-team.

ops: canary rollout scheduled. will also message Dedicated customers who opted into rotate beta.

maria: thanks team. adding unit test ticket and a doc note about "cache-key directionality normalization" to reduce future surprises."
